story.title: Nordic and Czech Nations Boycott Hockey World Championships Against Russia
story.summary: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, and the Czech Republic have announced their refusal to compete against Russia in the upcoming 2027 Men's Ice Hockey World Championships in Germany. This decision is part of a growing boycott movement, with six of the 16 participating nations now opting out of matches involving Russia.

related_stories.title: Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia Delayed to December Amid Security Concerns
related_stories.summary: The Asian Football Confederation has postponed the 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia from January to late December due to security concerns following recent Houthi attacks. The decision reflects the ongoing regional instability, which has also impacted other sporting events, including the Dakar Rally and the WTA Finals.

related_stories.title: Zelenskyy Seeks Path to Putin Meeting Through Abu Dhabi Talks
related_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed hope that upcoming talks in Abu Dhabi could pave the way for a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. During a meeting in Berlin with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, both leaders emphasized the importance of including the EU in peace negotiations with Russia. Merz voiced skepticism regarding Russia's commitment to a truce.
